_readme: S639 harvest side session, 2026-11-12. Rio Hondo College, second read. The first (rio_hondo_ge_units, run 43137946308) printed the transfer degree pages' own words: Sociology AA-T 24312 and Biology AS-T 24174 each end 'Cal-GETC Pattern (units will vary)' / 'Transferable Electives as needed to reach 60 transferable units' / 'DEGREE TOTAL 60 units', and their Summary says 'Completion of the California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC)'. No figure for Cal-GETC. The catalog's top navigation (_getNavigation?id=16&navigationtypeId=1) lists '7 - Degree & Certificate Guidelines' as node 22169 and '8 - Transfer' as node 22170, each a body page with no child list. This read prints each node's page JSON through the catalog's own _getPage call, with keywords narrowed to the general education figures, so the excerpts carry any sentence giving Cal-GETC's units. No model call.

questions.cal_getc_units: Does Rio Hondo's catalog print the units of the Cal-GETC pattern (section 7 or section 8), and in what words?
questions.local_ge_units: What does section 7 print for the Rio Hondo associate degree general education pattern and the 60-unit degree rule?
